NAGLE-BASIC.interpretation: August2022 section3.7.4 SHLD-7: with unacknowledged data, buffer new short segments until outstanding data is acknowledged or a full Eff.snd.MSS segment can be sent. This basic policy has fixed effective send MSS4 and applies to explicit choices and automatic Limited Transmit. Retransmission and persist probing retain parent semantics.

NAGLE-OPTION.interpretation: Section3.7.4 MUST-17: app.nodelay(enabled) toggles the per-connection disable flag in ESTABLISHED/CLOSE-WAIT. This finite API does not itself grant output; a subsequent transmit or accepted ACK grants the existing opportunity. Opening a new connection resets the flag to enabled Nagle.

NAGLE-SCOPE.interpretation: Basic RFC coalescing only, not complete sender SWS avoidance, lwIP unsent-node/FIN/memory-pressure/fast-recovery variations, dynamic MSS, or a general Linux/lwIP conformance claim. Old source profiles and Differences stay unchanged.
